config.max_drawable_count_scope: wgpu configuration before optional CAMetalDisplayLink; not a measured Metal display-link pool size
config.scroll_area_workload: 2s alternating top/bottom cycles: 0.35s finger, 0.65s OS-style momentum, 1s return/settle; routed through actual Gallery input

drop_detection.method: 显示链接 target_timestamp 间隔 > 1.5 x 刷新间隔
drop_detection.presented_time: 见 presentation：owned CAMetalLayer 的公开 addPresentedHandler 收据，另行统计实际呈现间隔

gpu_timing.covers: 只有我们的 render pass；不含合成器和 drawable 等待
gpu_timing.method: wgpu TIMESTAMP_QUERY：render pass 开始/结束时间戳，Metal stage boundary 计数器采样

presentation.method: public CAMetalLayer subclass nextDrawable + MTLDrawable.addPresentedHandler; optional benchmark-only receipts

process.cpu_rate_unit: 100% = one logical CPU core; getrusage user + system, sampled every 250ms

scene3d_workload.gpu_timing_scope: existing UI pass counters only; 3D compute/render are included in process CPU and actual presentation, not these GPU timestamps
